title: Filter mosaic
description: A tiled collection of textile patterns and places rearranges around the selected category.
useCase: Filter a visual collection without losing the identity of items that remain.
interaction: Choose a category and select a tile.

assets.description: Plum Garden at Kameido (Kameido Umeyashiki), from the series "One Hundred Famous Views of Edo (Meisho Edo hyakkei)"
Curving red running track with white lane lines

reducedMotion: The layout and selection change immediately; categories and image labels remain available.
limitations: Six local works in three preset categories. The layout uses measured FLIP transforms rather than a general masonry engine.
look: White page with pill filter chips over a mixed-width grid of image tiles: botanical textile prints, concrete architecture, a red running track, a woodblock print.
motion: Choosing a filter chip reflows the grid; surviving tiles FLIP from their old rectangles to new ones over 280 ms ease-out, newly shown tiles fade in over 180 ms.
adapt: `select` records each `data-tile` rectangle before `setFilter`; a `useLayoutEffect` then inverts the delta with `el.animate` (280 ms `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`) and fades new tiles over 180 ms. Replace `tiles` (`file`, `name`, `kind`) and filter values; `fm-wide` sets which tiles span two columns.
